payload.summary: I selected "generate_locator" in the Tools lens. The detail panel now shows a "generate_locator" article labelled "Browser tool". Its Arguments form has a Locator groups editor (Group 1 with a Container picker, "Pick on page" and "Add from tree"), an "Add group" button and a Run button that I did n…

endAnchors.text: Generate Playwright locators for elements, to write into Page Object Model code; does not act on the page. Structural Refs are capture-scoped: use them in tool calls, never in code. The locators are what belongs in a page object. Group targets by the container they belong to: a group's locators are…
One group per page object class. Leave the container empty for the page, or set it to a component's root: its locators are relative to it.

endAnchors.name: Pick an element on the page

goneAnchors.text: Press a key on the element that has focus. The result's changes_before lists what changed on the page since you last received it, before this action; changes lists what the action changed, anything that changed while the page settled after it included.
"Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as `ArrowLeft`, `a` or `ControlOrMeta+A`."
